Bill.BriefDescription: Promoting predictable funding for school districts that provide residential education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting predictable funding for schooldistricts that provide residential education; and adding new sectionsto chapter 28A.190 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.190RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The superintendent of public instruction shall submit to eachregular session of the legislature during an oddnumbered year a budgetrequest for residential education. (2) The superintendent of public instruction shall allocate fundingappropriated by the legislature for residential education to the schooldistricts and educational service districts that are required toconduct a program under this chapter and under RCW 13.04.145.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.190RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning with the 201011 school year, for those school districtsor educational service districts that provide instruction to studentsin state detention facilities under RCW 28A.190.010 or in county p. 1 2SHB 1969juvenile detention facilities under RCW 13.04.145, each such district'sallocations attributable to those facilities must be based onenrollment that is the greater of the current school year's enrollmentor ninety percent of the previous school year's enrollment.
